page.layout: Top: running title "INDEX." centred. Below it, two parallel columns of index entries (left column and right column), each with entry text and page numbers. Below the last lines: signature "t 3" at the left foot and catchword "pont*" at the right foot.
page.notes: The page is a two-column index whose rows pair entries across the columns; the lines are given in column order (left column first, then right). The sub-column cells are not separated by " | " because the printed wrapping runs across rows. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. The bottom "pont*" is a catchword and the "t 3" is a gathering signature. No page number is printed. The "pont*" in the catchword and "pont." abbreviations are as printed. Possible printing or reading doubt: "ac-" and "ueneno neca-" line breaks and the page numbers "394" and "186" in the left and right columns, which sit on the same printed row.
